local_names.this: caller-owned object holding the encoded field at this+0xF

summary: Decodes a 6-bit field from the dword at this+0xF: shifts right by 2, masks with 0x3F (isolating bits [7:2] of the byte at this+0xF), multiplies the result by the scale constant 55.549999 (flt_5ACCE4), and returns the product as a double. Straight-line thiscall with no guards. Called by VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0) and sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0).

operations.description: Read the dword at this+0xF and shift it right by 2 bit positions.
Mask the shifted value with 0x3F to isolate a 6-bit field.
Multiply the 6-bit field by the 55.549999 scale constant held in flt_5ACCE4.
Return the scaled value as double. Consumed by VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0) and sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0).

unresolved: The physical meaning of the 6-bit field and of the 55.549999 scale (flt_5ACCE4) is not determinable from this packet alone; the skeleton fill labels this function SixBitFieldToFloatDecoder (DERIVED) and the raw dword read spans the byte at this+0xF plus the three following bytes, but the 0x3F mask confines the extracted field to bits [7:2] of the byte at this+0xF.
